summary: Interactive Strength Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-7 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective June 29, 2026. The split reduced outstanding shares from ~3.6 million to ~514,400, with cash paid for fractional shares. The par value remained $0.0001, and trading symbol TRNR was unchanged. No board recommendation or advisor was named. This is a routine capital structure adjustment (reverse split), not a special situation. The filing also included a press release announcing the reverse split. There are no deal terms, as this is not an acquisition, divestiture, or similar event.
